content.value_statement: Remotion animation components can become difficult to adjust in Studio when their editable controls are unclear. This skill directs you to official guidance for designing interactive components and editable media timelines.
actual_capabilities: Links to official Remotion interactivity best practices.
Directs users to guidance for making elements and custom components interactive.
Identifies when video and audio clip projects need video-editing guidance.
Points users to Remotion markup practices for editable timeline clips.
Helps choose the relevant official documentation page for a Studio editing task.
limitations: It provides documentation links rather than implementing component changes.
It does not inspect a Remotion project or validate Studio behavior.
It does not replace Remotion API documentation or version-specific migration guidance.
It focuses on Remotion Studio editing workflows, not general video production.

prompt_templates.title: Find interactivity guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the Remotion guidance for making animations editable in Studio Visual Mode.

prompt_templates.title: Make a custom component editable
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a custom Remotion component. Point me to the official guidance for making its controls interactive in Studio.

prompt_templates.title: Choose guidance for a timeline

prompt_templates.title: Plan an editable composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a Remotion composition with editable visual controls and clip-based media. Identify which official interactivity and video-editing references apply.

output_examples.input: I need editable controls for a custom title component.
output_examples.output: Use the official guide for making a component interactive. It explains how to expose component controls in Remotion Studio.

output_examples.input: My composition contains many video and audio clips.
output_examples.output: Review the video-editing guidance for structuring Remotion markup so clips remain editable in the timeline.

best_practices: Use the linked official documentation before changing an interactive component design.
Keep editor-facing controls clear and focused on meaningful animation adjustments.
Use the video-editing guidance when clip editing is the main composition workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not expect this skill to modify project files automatically.
Do not use generic animation guidance when the task requires Studio-specific editing behavior.
Do not treat linked documentation as proof that a component is already interactive.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It directs you to official Remotion documentation for interactive and editable Studio workflows.

faq.question: Does this skill write Remotion code?
faq.answer: No. It provides focused documentation references and does not implement code changes.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Motion designers, frontend developers, and video automation engineers using Remotion Studio.

faq.question: When should I use the video-editing reference?
faq.answer: Use it when a component mainly contains video and audio clips that need timeline editing.

faq.question: Is this guidance specific to Remotion Studio?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on interactivity and editable workflows in Remotion Studio Visual Mode.

faq.question: Does this skill verify that my component is editable?
faq.answer: No. You must test the component in your Remotion project and Studio environment.
